chain.label: Maintenance manual silent on multiple drilled clamp nut holes
chain.trigger: The maintenance manual does not specify whether it is acceptable for the clamp nut to have multiple holes drilled

chain.label: Damaged drilled holes in clamp nut prevent full lock ring tang insertion
chain.trigger: Five holes had been drilled into the accident clamp nut threads; three holes were damaged to the extent that they would not have allowed for the full insertion of the lock ring pin

caused_by.evidence: The maintenance manual does not specify whether it is acceptable for the clamp nut to have multiple holes drilled; the investigation is exploring this issue.

chain.label: Stabilizer actuator lock ring missing or improperly installed
chain.trigger: the circular wire lock ring, which was designed to prevent the clamp nut from unscrewing, was not present

caused_by.evidence: it is possible for a lock ring not to be fully inserted into the clamp nut through those holes

chain.label: Clamp nut unscrewed from horizontal stabilizer actuator barrel
chain.trigger: the clamp nut that attaches the top eye end and bearing assembly of the horizontal stabilizer actuator ... had unscrewed from the barrel

caused_by.evidence: The examination also found that the circular wire lock ring, which was designed to prevent the clamp nut from unscrewing, was not present; ... no evidence that the threads failed in overstress

chain.label: Actuator no longer restrained the stabilizer, which could rotate uncontrollably
chain.trigger: If the clamp nut becomes unscrewed from the barrel during flight, the horizontal stabilizer would be able to rotate uncontrollably (trailing edge up or down) about its hinge

caused_by.evidence: If the actuator barrel and the clamp nut are not secured together and become separated, the actuator would not be able to control the position of the horizontal stabilizer

chain.label: Uncommanded climb to about 1,000 ft followed by rapid descent
chain.trigger: the airplane began a climb, reaching a maximum altitude of about 1,000 ft msl before entering a rapid descent

caused_by.evidence: the actuator would not be able to control the position of the horizontal stabilizer, resulting in a reduction or loss of pitch control

chain.label: Loss of pitch control; nose-low near-vertical descent
chain.trigger: the airplane ... pitched down in a nose-low, near-vertical descent until water impact

caused_by.evidence: resulting in a reduction or loss of pitch control
the airplane was in level flight before it entered a slight climb and then pitched down

chain.label: Airplane impacted the water in Mutiny Bay and sank
chain.trigger: a De Havilland Canada DHC-3, N725TH, impacted the water in Mutiny Bay, near Freeland, Washington, and sank

caused_by.evidence: entered a nose-down, near-vertical descent and impacted the water

chain.label: Pilot and nine passengers fatally injured; airplane destroyed
chain.trigger: The pilot and nine passengers were fatally injured, and the airplane was destroyed

caused_by.evidence: impacted the water in Mutiny Bay ... and sank
